text: Investigating the `Interval.fromISO` / `Settings.throwOnInvalid` bug in `src/interval.js`. ETA ~10 minutes.
Got it — investigating the `src/impl/util.js` bug (month arithmetic across the 100 barrier through February) in parallel. ETA ~12 minutes.
Got it — investigating the `src/datetime.js` bug (`isInDST()` for 1974 USA) in parallel. ETA ~15 minutes.
Got it — investigating the `src/duration.js` bug (`Duration#normalize can convert all unit pairs`) in parallel. ETA ~18 minutes.

Fixed. `Interval.fromISO` now guards each `DateTime.fromISO` call in try/catch and tracks validity booleans, so with `Settings.throwOnInvalid = true` valid duration-based intervals (e.g. `2020-01-01/P1Y`, `P1Y/2020-01-01`) no longer throw, and invalid input goes through `Interval.invalid(...)`. Verified: `npx jest test/interval` (127 tests) and `test/duration` (114 tests) pass; full suite unchanged apart from 2 pre-existing locale failures.
Got it — investigating the `src/impl/util.js` bug (`DateTime#toISODate() correctly pads negative years`) in parallel. ETA ~20 minutes.
Got it — investigating the `src/zones/fixedOffsetZone.js` bug (invalid FixedOffsetZone handling) in parallel. ETA ~22 minutes.

Fixed. `padStart` in `src/impl/util.js` now emits the sign separately so `n` counts only digits (`padStart(-50,4)` → `-0050`). `DateTime#toISODate()` for negative years now renders `-0050-05-25` etc. Verified: `test/datetime` (553 passed, only the 2 pre-existing French-locale failures) and `test/duration` (114/114) pass; full suite unchanged apart from those 2 pre-existing failures.
